main_body: Tall wall bookshelf with a plank top and three shelves holding scrolls, books and a chest, in a dark red-brown frame.
top_band: Light salmon-brown band at rows 1-4, then a dark step at row 5 where the frame and dark interior begin
evidence: Reading the middle column: rows 1-4 are a lighter top plank, row 5 is a darker overhang shade and front edge, then the front face from row 6 to 30. The shelves are inset in a dark cavity, with lighter shelf boards at rows 9-10, 17-18 and 25-26. A plinth at rows 28-31 sits below. The top is only about 4 rows and borderline, but it matches the guide's cabinet pattern (top band, edge, eave, recessed front) and is more than a 1-2px rim.

style.evidence: The frame and shelves use a brown ramp of about 5 steps. Outlines are dark reddish-brown, not black. Items on the shelves (scrolls, blue books, red books, chest) carry varied colours and highlights, so tiles have several colours each. The dark interior and the top plank are fairly smooth, but the shelf contents break up most of the surface. It sits close to the reference shelf in richness, if slightly thinner.
